title: Generalized mixed-duration financial screens and analyst evidence shape
points: Market-wide financial screens that combine balance-sheet strength with annual flow metrics now use a generalized mixed-duration screen contract instead of a one-off low-debt/CFO fallback.
The screen builder selects each metric on its correct statement basis: latest PIT rows for balance-sheet items and latest annual 12M rows for profit/loss or cash-flow items.
Screen tables now carry per-metric period fields and a basis note so analyst answers can disclose when leverage and cash-flow evidence come from different statement periods.
Plain P/E and P/B requests now use the curated valuation_inputs evidence package without also feeding noisy latest-interim net-profit rows into AnalystContext.
Sector ranking overrides now preserve broad sector market-data coverage instead of appending a duplicate top-10 market selector that can obscure the full peer set.
Analyst answer cleanup now normalizes valuation multiple glyphs and ROIC horizon titles so final wording matches deterministic coverage notes.
Router, lane, analyst prompt, spec, and repo skill guidance now document the same contract to reduce future ad hoc screen patches.

keystones.name: plain valuation inputs avoid interim earnings noise
sector screens keep the full peer set
